opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward the Polybius ICO by telling them to invest through token purchases: “You invest and buy tokens. In other words, you buy stocks or tokens.” It supplies a Polybius destination for that investment and highlights a 25% bonus. Participation is presented as offering possible company dividends and the ability to resell tokens for dollars, while the speaker predicts the project will succeed, saying, “Great bank. I think they will succeed.” These are concrete investment incentives tied to appreciation and dividends. The presentation does acknowledge that “no one tells us about the % yet” and does not guarantee a fixed return, but that limitation does not remove the solicitation to buy tokens based on a bonus, potential dividends, resale value, and expected project success.
